    Modern, sleek and refined

    Inspired by the iconic Galaxy S Series, the new Galaxy Tab A11 looks sleek and refined. Its streamlined silhouette and clean finish complete a premium design that stays true to the Galaxy identity. Available in classic Grey and Silver, the Galaxy Tab A11 blends well with your everyday style.1

    Bright, clear display with smooth motion

    Enjoy the Galaxy Tab A11's smooth and bright display, optimised for entertainment. Its high 90 Hz refresh rate delivers natural, fluid motion for watching videos, playing games, and browsing social media feeds. The display stays bright and clear even under direct sunlight, providing excellent visibility anytime, anywhere.2

    Store more of what you love

    The Galaxy Tab A11 offers ample memory and storage capacity. With up to 8 GB of memory, it enables fast, seamless multitasking, while 128 GB of storage provides plenty of space for large files. Plus, if needed, you can expand the storage up to 2 TB with a microSD card.3

    For your clearer face-to-face moments

    Stay closer to everyone who matters, face to face. The Galaxy Tab A11 comes with a 5 MP front camera for sharper, clearer video calls. Whether you're catching up with family or working with your team, enhanced clarity lets you see every smile and expression in lifelike detail.4

    Surround yourself with rich audio

    The Galaxy Tab A11 features Dolby-engineered Dual Speakers that deliver a rich, multidimensional audio experience. From your favourite playlists to the latest movies, the immersive 3D sound draws you into a soundscape that’s crisp, clear, and deeply engaging. The Galaxy Tab A11 also comes with a 3.5 mm audio jack, so you can conveniently enjoy your content with wired headphones.5

    Frequently Asked Questions

    Galaxy Tab A11 is a great choice for entertainment and web browsing. The 90 Hz display keeps scrolling smooth as you explore the web. Stay close to your loved ones, no matter the distance, with an improved front camera optimised for clearer face-to-face video calls. And with Dolby-engineered audio, everything you hear—whether it’s a movie or your favourite music—sounds more lifelike and immersive.

    Galaxy Tab A11 features a 1340 x 800 resolution display. Combined with a 90 Hz refresh rate, the display delivers smooth scene transitions and enables smooth scrolling through your social media feeds.

    When you unbox your new Galaxy Tab A11, you’ll find a quick start guide to get you set up, an ejection pin for the SIM/microSD tray, and a USB Type-C data cable for charging and connecting.6

    Galaxy Tab A11 comes with two memory options: 4 GB memory with 64 GB storage, or 8 GB memory with 128 GB storage. If you need more space, you can expand it with a microSD card (sold separately) for up to 2 TB of total storage. Store more, delete less.7

    Galaxy Tab A11 is powered by a 5,100 mAh battery that keeps up with your favourite activities, whether it's gaming, social media browsing, or binge-watching.8

    Yes, you can quickly and easily transfer your iOS data to Galaxy Tab A11 using Smart Switch. Smart Switch is a tool that simplifies transferring data from one device to another by allowing you to seamlessly move contacts, photos, videos, notes, calendar events and more. You can connect your new Galaxy Tab A11 to your old device using a cable or wirelessly using the Smart Switch app.9

    Galaxy Tab A11 is available in two confident colours: Grey and Silver10

    Galaxy Tab A11 embodies the Galaxy S Series’ signature design, featuring refined details in every corner, including the speaker hole, cam deco, and side buttons.

    If you're looking for a sleek and versatile lifestyle companion, Galaxy A11 is the perfect choice. The 90 Hz refresh rate ensures smooth transitions from scene to scene and makes scrolling through your social media feed fluid and responsive. The 5 MP front camera adds clarity to your face-to-face moments during video calls. The tablet also embodies the Galaxy S Series’ signature design, which is modern and sleek.

    When you buy from Samsung.com, you get access to exclusive benefits including Trade In and Samsung Care+. If you purchase your Galaxy Tab A11 from us, you can receive discounts towards your new smartphone when you trade in almost any device including smartphones, wearables and tablets. Samsung Care+ is coverage for your new device that extends beyond the standard warranty, offering protection against accidental damage and providing more peace of mind to our customers.11

    Storage : 64 GB | Colour : Grey

    [This review was collected as part of a promotion.] This is a screen that belongs in 2011, and quite frankly at this price point I have never seen such an unpleasant display on a modern tablet. There is no need to compromise this much on screen resolution for a modern tablet, it is impossible. I am stunned, it is unusable, I can't create art on this because of the resolution, I can not watch shows or videos, I cannot even read because the text is hurting my eyes due to the obnoxious pixels on each letter. I have never used a device with a screen this bad in my entire life. This is a tablet for children and 80 year olds who do not know better. I am never buying a Samsung tablet again. Shame on you Samsung.
    Originally posted on Samsung UK

    Response from Samsung:
    2026-10-04

    Samsung

    We're sorry to hear that you're disappointed with your Galaxy Tab A11, Gabriel, particularly with the screen resolution and the impact this has had on your overall experience. We appreciate that display quality is an important factor when choosing a tablet, especially for activities such as creating artwork, reading and watching content. The TFT LCD display has a 90Hz refresh rate and is designed to deliver smoother scrolling, fluid animations, and seamless video playback. To adjust the display, go to Settings > Display. From this menu, you can customise a variety of screen options. Meanwhile, a soft reset can clear any temporary glitches. To do this, press and hold the Side key and Volume Down key for around ten seconds, or until the tablet reboots. If the issues continue, please don't hesitate to contact our Support Team, who are on hand to help. You can find our contact details and opening times here: https://www.samsung.com/uk/support/contact/ Thank you for taking the time to share your review.
    ^EW at Samsung Support

    Vloeiender dan verwacht voor deze prijs. De Samsung Galaxy Tab A11 is een uitstekende budgettablet die opvalt door de indrukwekkende softwareondersteuning van zeven jaar. De schermresolutie van 1340 x 800 pixels is aan de lage kant, wat de scherpte beïnvloedt. Bovendien wordt er geen snellader meegeleverd, wat het opladen vertraagt. Als dit niet meer het geval is in de Veilige modus, dan wordt dit waarschijnlijk veroorzaakt door een app van een andere ontwikkelaar en kan je het beste eventjes met een fijne kam door jouw lijst met geïnstalleerde apps gaan. Op deze pagina vind je meer informatie over hoe je jouw toestel in de Veilige modus zet: https://www.samsung.com/nl/support/mobile-devices/how-to-start-my-galaxy-device-in-safe-mode/.
